targets.expected_type:
∀ {A : Type} [DecidableEq A] (f : A → ℝ) (B : Finset A) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (a : A) (ha : f a ≤ B.sup' hB f) (S : Finset A),
    baseMax f B hB (insert a S) = baseMax f B hB S
targets.scope: Finite powerset cancellation for maxima with a nonempty base; the dominated element may depend on the evaluation point.

targets.expected_type:
∀ {A : Type} [DecidableEq A] (S : Finset A) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ S)
    (F : Finset A → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ T ⊆ S.erase a, F (insert a T) = F T),
    (∑ T ∈ S.powerset, (-1 : ℝ)^T.card * F T) = 0
targets.scope: Finite powerset cancellation for maxima with a nonempty base; the dominated element may depend on the evaluation point.

targets.expected_type:

targets.expected_type:
∀ {I : Type} [Fintype I] (p : Polynomial I)
    (hcard : Fintype.card I + 1 < Fintype.card p.Terms),
    ∃ c : p.Terms → ℝ, (∑ i, c i) = 0 ∧ (∑ i, c i • p.slope i) = 0 ∧ ∃ i, c i ≠ 0

targets.expected_type:

    Fintype.card (restrict p S hS).Terms = S.card
